content.title: SINNERS Accepts the Oscar for Cinematography
content.text: Sign in to confirm you’re not a bot This helps protect our community. Learn more 113,916 views • Mar 15, 2026 The Oscar for Cinematography goes to SINNERS! Congratulations to Autumn Durald Arkapaw on taking home the Oscar. See more Oscar acceptance speeches and highlights on Oscars.com. ...more ...more 200 Comments Add a comment... Mr. Coogler is a class act for running to get her son. She just made history!! First woman to officially win the Academy Award for Best Cinematography If you watched this in IMAX you know why she won. love how the sinners crew cheering and being happy for each others wins! I KNEW she was gonna win. Sinners was beautifully and masterfully shot. I love how Ryan Coogler includes everybody. Like, everybody has a seat at the table. Yes, the ladies made a Stand at the Oscar's. All Ladies Stand! Epic! First woman in history! Wow!!! Deserved that standing ovation to be the FRIST WOMAN IN HISTORY to win for cinematography is no slight feet after almost 100 years and only three other women ever nominated, and for her to be a black woman to win only adds more. I wish her to have the most incredible career going forward more than she already has. It means so much to myself who is going in the cinematography as a woman and to see this gives me SO MUCH HOPE Sinners is making history tonight Congratulations all of the Sinners personnel Ryan Coogler and all!!!!
